title: Record courier COD collection evidence
prerequisites: A simulated booked COD consignment and fictional gross collection evidence.

scenes.title: Find the workflow
scenes.narration: COD collection evidence concerns money collected from the customer by the courier. Open COD payouts. Distinguish booked COD, gross customer collection, courier fees and net payout: these values are related but they are not interchangeable.

scenes.title: Understand the controls
scenes.narration: Find the intended consignment or collection record. Verify the provider reference, currency and gross amount collected. Enter the collection reference and a factual evidence note through the supported controls.

scenes.title: Perform the task
scenes.narration: Record only evidence you actually have. A net bank payout after fees is not the same as gross customer collection. Review mismatches instead of inventing a manual payment to make the customer order appear fully paid.

scenes.title: Verify and continue
scenes.narration: Check the order payment totals and collection history after reconciliation. Keep fees and payout evidence distinct. This demonstration uses fictional simulator records; it does not request or confirm a real provider payout.
